exposure: Laparoscopic surgical management for heterotopic pregnancy (HP)
cohort: 21 patients diagnosed with heterotopic pregnancy (HP) after in vitro fertilization and embryo transfer (IVF-ET) who underwent laparoscopic surgical management.
finding: Laparoscopic surgery is a safe and effective treatment for heterotopic pregnancy, with most patients achieving satisfactory pregnancy outcomes and no anomalies observed in the surviving neonates at birth.
